#### 🛡️ Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] Verified that NO `.env` files, API keys, or secret tokens are committed
- [ ] Ran `npm run check:secrets` and it passed cleanly
- [ ] Synced with latest `main` before opening PR (`git pull origin main`)
- [ ] Attached a screenshot / GIF / Loom preview below (if UI changes were made)
